name: Controls > Adjustments offers and writes AUX 1 to AUX 13 only
step: Check the Adjustments AUX channel range
rationale:
Issue #2673: the Enable and Value channel pickers on Controls > Adjustments offered AUX 1 to AUX 20, but the firmware's MAX_AUX_CHANNEL_COUNT is 13 (18 - 5). An index above it is refused by the CLI and reads past rcInput[] in rc_adjustments.c, and the write path did not clamp it.

The page now offers 13 channels, and msp_adjustments.lua clamps the enable and adjustment channel bytes to AUX 1..13 on write. 255 (always on) is written as is.

The harness pins the clamp on the real codec (AUX 14 and 21 written as 13, AUX 1 and 13 unchanged, 255 kept) and reads the page's picker count from its source. --self-test removes the clamp and requires the clamp check to go red.
